instruction: Enable Thunderbird for alerts@monitoring.net so it can send outgoing emails while disabling any incoming message reception.

metadata.explanation: This task verifies Thunderbird is configured for send-only mode by checking: (1) email identity is alerts@monitoring.net, (2) SMTP server is configured for outgoing mail, (3) no incoming POP3/IMAP server is configured.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all three requirements from the instruction
Requirement 1 (email identity): Checks mail.identity.id1.useremail == 'alerts@monitoring.net' - correctly verifies the email identity configuration
Requirement 2 (outgoing mail): Checks mail.smtpservers contains 'smtp' - correctly verifies SMTP server is configured for sending emails
Requirement 3 (no incoming mail): Checks mail.server.server1.type not in ['pop3', 'imap'] - correctly verifies no incoming mail server is configured
Data flow is correct: get_vm_file extracts prefs.js (contains Thunderbird settings) -> check_thunderbird_prefs parses and validates preferences
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure prefs.js is flushed to disk before verification
Metric function logic is sound: parses user_pref() lines, evaluates JSON values, applies expect/unexpect rules correctly
Complete coverage: all aspects of send-only configuration (identity, SMTP enabled, incoming disabled) are verified

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
